name: Default
shortDescription: Browser-based motion graphics and compositing studio built in Rust and WebAssembly: layers, keyframes, 308 effects, 3D cameras and lights, Lottie import and export, and a render queue.

alerts.message: Projects and media are not stored on the server: the studio runs in the browser and keeps projects in that browser's storage. Save projects and renders to your own device.
The upstream project publishes no container image; this one is built by a community maintainer from the source of the official release tags.
